ownership_decision.invariant: run decides how much a Run may spend: it reads the operator-set ceiling or the deployment's when the Run is created, reserves it and records it in the Run's policy snapshot.

boundary_decision.interaction: No new collaboration: run already reserves credits through the ledger port injected at the entrypoint; only the amount it passes changed.

domain_forces: The run ceiling lived only in SKILLHUB_RUN_MAX_BUDGET_USD, so operators had to redeploy to change what a run may spend.
A Run's attempts and its reservation must agree on one ceiling even when the setting changes between creation and dispatch.
implementation_design.decision: An operator-set ceiling in a single-row table, read at admission and copied into the Run's policy snapshot; reservation uses that copy and every attempt reads it from the snapshot.
invariants_preserved: A Workspace that cannot cover the ceiling is refused before any run row exists.
Runs created before the change keep the deployment ceiling, which an absent snapshot field falls back to.
rejected_alternatives: Reading the setting on every attempt: a Run created under one ceiling would be dispatched under another, after credits were reserved for the first.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Reserving the deployment ceiling instead of the snapshot's at admission fails TestARunReservesAndKeepsTheCeilingInForceWhenItWasCreated.

record.statement: When a credit ledger is configured, a Run is admitted only if the Workspace can reserve the run budget in force when it is created: the operator-set ceiling, or the deployment's when none is set. The Run keeps that ceiling in its policy snapshot, and its attempts run under it whatever the setting becomes later; a Workspace that cannot reserve it is refused with credit_balance.
examples: A Workspace with 100 credits is refused with credit_balance under a 0.50 USD ceiling and admitted once the operator lowers it to 0.05 USD.
A Run created under a 0.05 USD ceiling issues its first gateway key at 0.05 USD after the operator raises the ceiling to 2 USD.
A deployment with no credit ledger admits the Run without a reservation.

approvals.scope: rule amendment: run budget in force at creation
